Name: JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=4][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaFlex [/color][/b]- Complete contracts at YOUR discretion! [b]Flexible [/b]hours, [b]flexible[/b] you,[b] flexible [color=#6d9eeb]Joja[/color][/b]![/size][/quote]
[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color]is now looking for freelance suppliers! [/b]None of those pesky "hourly wages" and "benefits" here.

Inside [b]JojaMart [/b]is the new [b]JojaFlex [/b]terminal. Interacting with it will show you the current [b]supply contract for the week[/b].

[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaFlex Terminal[/color][/b]
• Each week (resetting on [b]Monday[/b]), a new contract will be posted
• Contracts request items that are either seasonal or available year round (Don't worry if you can't complete one, they'll come back around!)
• Deliver the required items to the [b]JojaFlex bin[/b] directly next to the terminal
       -Any combination of quality is valid, as well as any flavor of honey, or colors of flower. You can also do partial deposits.
• Be given your reward: [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaBoxes[/b][/color]!

If you have Cornucopia [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Flowers[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url] installed, those have a chance to pop up as a contract!
None of them are required.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaBoxes[/color][/b]
• Completing a contract earns you [b]5 JojaBoxes[/b]
• They can be opened at the Blacksmith
• They contain a variety of items chosen randomly. [b]Good luck!

[/b]For slightly spoiler-y info on the JojaBoxes:
[spoiler]They're about 3/4 of the loot pool of Mystery Boxes, and 1/4 my own loot pool.  There's some good drops in them if you're lucky!
There's also trash!
Or, if you have my other Joja products installed, there's a chance for them as well![/spoiler]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]Premium Contracts[/color][/b]
• After purchasing the [b]JojaMart Membership[/b], 20% chance each week for a contract to be a "[b]Premium Contract[/b]"
• Premium contracts request [b]artisan goods[/b]
• Completed Premium contracts will reward [b]5 [color=#ffd966]Golden [/color]JojaBoxes[/b]
• Golden JojaBoxes have more and rarer contents than regular JojaBoxes

For definitely [b]spoiler-y[/b] info on the Golden JojaBoxes:
[spoiler]They have the same basic loot pool as the regular JojaBoxes (with increased quantities), but they also have:
Higher chance for Prismatic Shards
Rare chance for: Auto Petter, Golden Animal Cracker, and various other goodies!
There's also still trash![/spoiler]


No reason not to shop while you're doing your JojaFlex job! Check out: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more Joja snacks!

There's also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields!
[b]
Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Not really compatible with:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28950]No More Lag[/url] - I place the terminal/bin dynamically on map load. No More Lag stops maps from loading normally. I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37301?tab=description]SinZational Speedy Solutions[/url] for performance!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14681]Joja Lottery[/url] - We occupy the same space. 

Doesn't directly edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with most other mods that edit the store, as long as they don't place anything in the same spot.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: My misc Joja Mods, Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch, VPR-Inspired UI, Peachy Objects, Soft Farmer)

Downloads.Description:
A retexture patch to match Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367

This is what I'm using in my main screenshots.

After installing main file, extract into your mods folder and say yes to overwriting.
JojaMart is now looking for freelance suppliers! Inquire at your local JojaMart today!
